query:
UPDATE event.venues SET
               name    = $2::jsonb,
               kind    = $3,
               address = $4,
               map_url = $5::text::platform.url,
               area        = $6::jsonb,
               access_note = $7::jsonb,
               latitude    = $8::float8::numeric(9,6),
               longitude   = $9::float8::numeric(9,6)
         WHERE id = $1
